AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.

4. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.

5. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.

9. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

10. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.

11. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

6. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

7. A — CPU

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

12. A — Information and Communication Technology
